name: light
qss: QMainWindow, QDialog, QMenuBar, QMenu, QWidget { background-color: #eff1f5; color: #4c4f69; } QLineEdit, QPlainTextEdit, QTextEdit, QTableView, QTreeView, QListView, QListWidget { background-color: #ffffff; color: #4c4f69; selection-background-color: #dce0e8; selection-color: #4c4f69; border: 1px solid #ccd0da; } QHeaderView::section { background-color: #e6e9ef; color: #4c4f69; border: none; padding: 4px; } QMenuBar::item:selected, QMenu::item:selected { background-color: #dce0e8; } QPushButton { background-color: #dce0e8; border: 1px solid #ccd0da; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 4px; color: #4c4f69; } QPushButton:hover { background-color: #ccd0da; } QSplitter::handle { background-color: #ccd0da; } QStatusBar { border-top: 1px solid #ccd0da; }
